newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates surge on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates surge on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates surged amid shortage of funds and a lack of lending interest, dealers said.
They said the rates were likely to maintain higher levels on Wednesday as no major inflows were expected.

The overnight funds were traded mostly at 16.95 percent but lenders were more interested in placing their funds in one week rather than overnight at 16.75 percent, a dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank said. At the end of the day heavy amount was discounted with the State (central) Bank of Pakistan, the dealer said.
